lines.speaker: old_maud
lines.text: I heard a fisher's boy is missing. I'll keep my fire ready if he finds his way here. As for that old bear... hunger wakes before a creature does. Go gently, if you can.
lines.direction: Ancient, papery, unhurried; lucid concern under the cackle. No grand revelation.

lines.speaker: old_maud
lines.text: The boy reached my fire, and I sent him home to his father. Poor old bear. A hundred winters, and the last was the coldest. Keep the claw; there is nothing else down there to carry home.
lines.direction: Ancient, papery, unhurried; a small grief, without explaining its cause.
